title: Creamy Paneer Butter Masala
ingredients: THULIRVA Fresh Farm Paneer (200g), THULIRVA Pure Bilona Cow Ghee (2 tbsp), Tomatoes (4 ripe), Cashews (12-15), Kashmiri Red Chili, Kasuri Methi, Fresh Cream (2 tbsp), Ginger-Garlic paste, Garam Masala
instructions:
1. Soak cashews in warm water and blend with fresh tomatoes into a silky smooth puree.
2. Heat Bilona Cow Ghee in a heavy kadai. Add bay leaf, cinnamon, and ginger-garlic paste; saute until fragrant.
3. Pour in the tomato-cashew puree and cook on medium flame until oil separates.
4. Add Kashmiri red chili, turmeric, coriander, and salt.
5. Gently slide in fresh THULIRVA paneer cubes and simmer for 4 minutes.
6. Finish with crushed kasuri methi, a pinch of garam masala, and fresh farm cream. Serve hot with rotis or naan.
description: Rich, luscious tomato-cashew makhani gravy gently spiced with Kashmiri red chili and kasuri methi, studded with velvety soft cubes of farm paneer and finished with golden butter.

title: Aromatic Ghee Pongal
ingredients: Raw Rice (1 cup), Yellow Moong Dal (1/2 cup), THULIRVA Pure Bilona Cow Ghee (4 tbsp), Whole Black Pepper (1 tsp), Cumin Seeds (1 tsp), Fresh Ginger (1 inch grated), Curry Leaves (2 sprigs), Cashews (10-12 halves), Asafoetida (hing)
instructions:
1. Dry roast yellow moong dal until lightly fragrant. Combine with washed raw rice and 4.5 cups water; pressure cook for 4 whistles until soft and mushy.
2. In a small pan, heat 3 tbsp of fragrant Bilona Cow Ghee.
3. Roast cashews until golden; set aside.
4. In the same ghee, crackle cumin seeds, crushed black pepper, grated ginger, curry leaves, and a pinch of hing.
5. Pour the aromatic tempering over the mashed rice-dal pongal, season with rock salt, and stir in remaining ghee. Garnish with golden cashews.
description: Traditional South Indian rice and moong dal tempered with crushed black pepper, fiery ginger, crunchy roasted cashews, and generous spoonfuls of golden A2 Cow Ghee.

title: Golden Kesar Badam Milk
ingredients: THULIRVA Pure Fresh Cow Milk (500ml), Kashmiri Saffron (Kesar, 12 strands), Raw California Almonds (15 soaked and peeled), Raw Forest Honey or Organic Rock Sugar (2 tbsp), Green Cardamom Powder (1/4 tsp), Crushed Pistachios
instructions:
1. Soak saffron strands in 2 tbsp warm milk for 10 minutes to release the royal golden hue.
2. Grind soaked, peeled almonds with a splash of milk into a smooth paste.
3. Bring fresh whole cow milk to a gentle boil in a heavy-bottomed vessel.
4. Whisk in the almond paste, infused saffron milk, and green cardamom powder. Simmer for 5 minutes on low flame while stirring.
5. Remove from heat, stir in pure wild honey, and garnish with sliced pistachios and saffron threads. Serve warm or chilled.
description: Warm farm-fresh whole milk infused with freshly crushed Kashmiri saffron threads, slivered almonds, nutmeg, and sweetened with raw forest honey.

title: Traditional Mysore Pak
ingredients: Gram Flour (Besan, 1 cup sieved), THULIRVA Pure Bilona Cow Ghee (2 cups warm), Organic Sugar (1.5 cups), Water (1/2 cup)
instructions:
1. Sieve besan and mix with 1/2 cup warm melted Bilona Ghee to form a lump-free batter.
2. In a heavy broad pan, combine sugar and water; boil to one-string consistency.
3. Gradually pour the besan batter into the boiling syrup, stirring continuously on medium-low heat.
4. In another pan, keep the remaining 1.5 cups ghee warm.
5. Gradually add ladles of warm ghee to the simmering besan mixture, stirring vigorously as the mixture absorbs the ghee and bubbles vigorously.
6. When the mixture turns porous, frothy, and leaves the sides of the pan, transfer immediately to a greased tray.
7. Allow to rest for 10 minutes and cut into neat diamond shapes while warm.
description: Melt-in-the-mouth heritage delicacy crafted from roasted gram flour, organic raw sugar, and abundant fragrant Bilona Cow Ghee.

title: Masala Chai with Pure Farm Milk
ingredients: THULIRVA Fresh Cow Milk (250ml), Filtered Water (150ml), Premium Estate Black Tea Leaves (2 tsp), Fresh Ginger (crushed 1 inch), Green Cardamom (3 crushed), Cinnamon Bark (1/2 inch), Cloves (2), Brown Sugar or Jaggery (2 tsp)
instructions:
1. In a saucepan, bring water to a boil with crushed ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves for 2 minutes to extract the spices.
2. Add estate tea leaves and simmer for 1 minute.
3. Pour in rich THULIRVA whole cow milk and sweeten with raw sugar.
4. Bring to a rolling boil twice, allowing the tea to brew into a deep amber-caramel tone.
5. Strain through a fine tea sieve into clay kulhads and serve piping hot.
description: Rich, creamy whole cow milk simmered with fresh ginger, crushed green cardamom pods, cinnamon bark, and premium estate Assam black tea.
